title: Market prices around policy decisions and press conferences

banks.label: Federal Reserve

windowDefinitions.statement: 10 min before to 20 min after the statement.
windowDefinitions.conference: 10 min before to 60 min after the press conference begins.

banks.quoteTimingNote: The closing release quote and opening conference quote use the same ten-minute median-price interval when the events are 30 minutes apart. Positive quote-gap minutes indicate the time between separate intervals. All times are local.
